tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Editorial grid with variable story weight. Navigation and content order support broad audiences and urgent contexts.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.
tokens.role: Humanist sans type keeps instructions and repeated controls approachable without softening their meaning. Story prominence changes without breaking reading sequence.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: Text, audio, video, live information, and imagery keep distinct roles.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Semantics, input modes, and legibility shape the system rather than decorate it.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Responsive news hierarchy with one live marker and distinct text-media roles. Product, photography, illustration, and data each receive a separate job.
